integrity: The result is supported by an exact path-forest forced-edge formula, a complete 17-signature table, exact bounded substitution, and a uniform symbolic positivity argument. Two independent finite checkers are provided; they are not substitutes for the all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: Only Walsh frequencies with at most four edge coordinates are classified. The theorem does not classify all frequencies or condition numbers, and earlier published computations subsume isolated observations at order nine and certain other orders. Priority is qualified by the literature comparisons and residual risks in AUDIT.json.
title: Sparse Walsh zeros of undirected Hamiltonian tours: the exceptional orders nine and ten
